roadmap_item: area I, the follow-on 97ff71f names: the capped-sum (additive envelope) combination against measured RNA in the thirteen reader cells, as its own registration, on 7d's and 7h's design
question: the multi-element genes the capped sum runs on 7d's design, beside 7d's and 7h's forms (no RNA read)
census: a count on the predictor side, before any RNA value is read (data/results/capsumrna_census.json), over the 24 compiled programs gated as 7d gated them: of the multi-element genes combine2.classify admits, how many the capped sum fits, by root, and why the rest are not fitted; 7d's mean and competition counts recomputed beside them and checked against data/results/combine2_census.json; on every gene with an uncapped root the largest difference, over the thirteen cells, between its closed-form prediction and the mean's; every informative gene run by the runtime under activator_combination='sum_capped' with combine2's HARNESS checks, on each root it has; the genes informative under all four forms (mean, competition, multiplicative, the capped sum's unique root). It reads no RNA value
form_source: runtime/grn.py combine_activators 'sum_capped': A = min(1, W), W = sum of s_i*H(x_i) over the gene's activating rules, a held rule counted at strength 0; inhibitors multiply, R = prod (1 - s_j*H(x_j)). One of the four rules lane-combine compared (grn.ACTIVATOR_RULES; grn.COMBINATION_TEST, registered 2026-09-28: 'sum_capped max <= P <= S1+S2'), selectable for one run with NetworkRuntime(activator_combination='sum_capped'). lane-strengthform's 'additive_envelope' (strengthform.COMPARATORS) is the interval sum_capped and or give on an enhancer pair in boost units, max(b1, b2) <= boost <= log2(2**b1 + 2**b2 - 1), the upper end being the capped sum below its cap; this lane runs the capped sum itself, in the engine's units, and not or
conventions: combine2's, unchanged (FIT['mean']): every element at its intact state x = bridge.INTACT, so H(x) = bridge.H_INTACT = 0.5; the strongest activating element at bridge.DECLARED_STRENGTH (s = 1), the others in proportion to their drops; an inhibitor's s_j*h = e_j/(q + e_j). The cap is the engine's 1 in those units. No number is added

fit.principle: the bridge's: the run reproduces each element's own removal observation RHO_i = 2**(log2 fold change on deletion) exactly at the state where every element of the gene is present (S5, 'direction and fold ... are the input'), and the gene's intact transcription is its rate T (measured, else the borrowed median; no fold prediction depends on T)
fit.sum_capped: d_i = 1 - RHO_i (activating), e_j = RHO_j - 1 (inhibiting), D = sum d_i, top = max d_i. The strongest at s = 1 fixes Z = V*R0/T = top/H and each term t_i = d_i/Z, so W = H*D/top at the intact state. UNCAPPED ROOT (W <= 1): the cap binds in no cell, since a hold only lowers W; q = D, b = T(1 - q), the inhibitors and every s as combine2.fit('mean') gives them, and V = T*top/(H*R0) (the mean's V without its n). CAPPED ROOT (the cap binding at the intact state, W = 1 + c, c > 0): removing i lowers A from 1 to 1 - d_i/Z, so t_i = d_i/Z + c, and the strongest at s = 1 gives Z = ((k-1)*top - D)/(H*(k-1) - 1), c = (1 - D/Z)/(k-1), q = Z, k the number of activating elements. Level relative to T with the open set O: (1 - q) + Z*min(1, sum of t_i over open activators) * prod over closed inhibitors (1 + e_j/q)
fit.runnable: a gene is runnable under the capped sum when combine2.fit('mean') is (q < 1, every s in (0, 1]), its W <= 1 (+ bridge.STRENGTH_TOLERANCE), and no capped root exists beside the uncapped one; otherwise it is reported by reason: the mean's reason, sum_past_the_cap, or fit_not_unique; a gene with a capped root and no uncapped one is capped_root_only, its one fit the capped root

structure.identity_with_the_mean: the reader's hold is a strength-0 copy of the rule, kept, and the bridge's removal a clamp at 0, kept; under both the mean is linear in the element terms (closing element i lowers transcription by d_i of T whatever the others do), and so is the capped sum while W <= 1. On its uncapped root the capped sum therefore gives, in every reader cell, the mean's level, and its centred prediction is 7d's P_mean. Its population is a subset of the mean's (the mean's runnable genes with W <= 1)
structure.no_fit_past_the_cap: a capped root needs c > 0, i.e. Z > D, and with H*(k-1) > 1 that is (k-1)*top - D > D*(H*(k-1) - 1), i.e. D < top/H: the uncapped W = H*D/top below 1. With H*(k-1) <= 1 (k <= 3 at H = 0.5) no capped root has Z > 0 and c > 0 at all. So a gene whose uncapped W exceeds 1 has no fit at these conventions (sum_past_the_cap): the strongest term is H, and with the cap binding no removal can lower A by as much as its observation needs
structure.a_second_root: with four or more activating elements (H*(k-1) > 1) and D < top/H, the capped root exists beside the uncapped one when its q = Z < 1 and its inhibitors fit: both reproduce every removal and T at the same conventions, so the fit is not unique (fit_not_unique). The capped root's prediction differs from the mean's; it is counted and run, never chosen, because the definition does not choose between the roots
structure.a_capped_root_alone: the capped root's element-driven share q = Z exceeds the uncapped root's q = D, and an inhibitor's fitted s_j*h = e_j/(q + e_j) falls as q rises, so a gene the mean refuses with inhibitor_strength_above_1 can have a capped root and no uncapped one (capped_root_only). Its one fit is the capped root, and the mean has no prediction for it. A gene the mean refuses with basal_not_positive (D >= 1) has none, since Z > D
structure.what_the_bridge_licenses: where the cap binds, how far it binds is set by the strength scale, which bridge.DECLARED_STRENGTH fixes by convention: the absolute scale of one gene's transcription and its basal fraction, in molecules/(cell*h); not the ceiling, not the strength, and not the response to any perturbation but this removal. At a smaller declared scale every gene the mean runs is uncapped, and the capped sum is the mean on every one of them
structure.what_is_assumed: that a gene's k observations were taken at one state. Under the reader selection a gene's rules come from k different argmax tracks; the joint fit treats them as one intact state, and each reader cell's run transports them there, as M2b transported one rule's m
structure.inhibitor_only: a gene with no activating rule has A = 1 under every activator form, so the forms cannot differ on it and its q is fixed by no observation; it is not run
structure.network: no compiled rule's source is a gene (runrules census): one independent system per gene

decision_rule: fixed before the census was counted, from STRUCTURE: no registration and no RNA run if (1) every gene with a unique fit has the mean's prediction in every reader cell within CLOSED_FORM_TOLERANCE, and (2) the runtime under activator_combination='sum_capped' gives the closed form on every informative gene run. Then 7d's run has already read the RNA of every gene the capped sum runs with a unique fit, under the same prediction (data/results/combine2_result.json, genes_tables), so a registration on 7d's design would re-read a subset of 7d's committed mean with its outcome in the record, and its head-to-head against the mean would be zero by construction. The capped root, where it exists, is a choice the definition does not make, set by a strength scale the bridge says licenses nothing beyond the single removal; it is counted for the coordinator's decision and not registered here. If either condition fails, the registration goes ahead on the genes where the two differ
exploration_preceded_this: combine2.py, multrna.py, saturate.py, strengthform.py and their census scripts, and the per-form counts of data/results/combine2_census.json and multrna_census.json (predictor side, no RNA value); one unsaved smoke run of scripts/capsumrna_census.py on chr21, after DECISION and STRUCTURE were written and before this code was committed, which changed neither. No RNA table and no genes table of 7d or 7h was opened; their registered readings were known from the lane brief and docs/ROADMAP.md. After 43dd4ac: one full census run from it in a clean worktree, which stopped with an exception at SPMIP4 and wrote nothing (the correction in the module docstring); one unsaved full census run of the corrected code before it was committed, whose counts led to SIZE_CHECK being written (7d's DECISION 2, not a new rule)
sentence: of the 17,983 multi-element genes combine2.classify admits, the capped sum at combine2's conventions fits 2,288 on its uncapped root (15,695 are not fitted: 12500 basal_not_positive, 2649 sum_past_the_cap, 546 inhibitor_strength_above_1); on every one of them its prediction in the thirteen reader cells is the runtime's mean's (largest difference 6.7e-16 in log2), and the runtime under activator_combination='sum_capped' gives the closed form on every informative gene it ran, on either root (2,282 runs of a gene on a root, 0 of them failing the harness). 126 of the 2,288 also have a second, capped root, on which the capped sum differs from the mean (125 informative under it). 3 genes have only a capped root (3 informative under it, 3 of those with a symbol on one gene_id), the mean having no fit for them (3 inhibitor_strength_above_1). 2,165 genes have a unique fit, 3 of them with a prediction other than the mean's; 2,032 are informative and 1,498 informative under all four forms, before the RNA tables' row check
size_check_rule: 7d's DECISION 2, part of the design this lane was asked to register on: a population of fewer than MIN_GENES genes is NOT_TESTABLE, no comparison read. Applied to the genes whose unique fit differs from the mean's, informative, with a symbol on one gene_id (POPULATION (f)'s row check, which needs the RNA tables' rows, can only lower the count): below MIN_GENES no registration is written and no RNA table is opened. It was written after an unsaved census run showed the count (EXPLORATION_PRECEDED_THIS)
money: none: no request is sent and no key is read

observations unreadable or exactly 1, actions that disagree with the observation

entry_script.why: argv[0] is a file inside this repository that git tracks and reports unmodified: the commit holds the code that wrote the bytes, so a rebuild can run it. The only clean form
entry_script.forms_are_decided_in_advance: genomeos.manifest.ENTRY_FORMS: one clean form (a tracked, unmodified file inside this repository), every other form refuses, and a form that cannot be classified is 'unknown' and refuses too. Read from sys.argv[0] at write time, never declared

code_cleanliness.counting_path_is_computed: the transitive import closure of this script, computed from the files' import statements at write time (genomeos.manifest.counting_path), never by importing: it follows every import that resolves to a file in this repository rather than only the package, counts the __init__.py of each package above a module, resolves bare imports against the directories the source literally puts on sys.path as well as the repository root, and matches every path component against what its directory lists, so a class name such as genomeos.genome.Genome cannot enter it as a file; not a hand-written list
code_cleanliness.note: several lanes work in this one checkout. A file under foreign_uncommitted_code belongs to another lane; this lane did not write it and did not commit it. The counting path is the computed closure above, so a foreign file outside it cannot have entered a number here, and foreign_uncommitted_code_on_the_counting_path names any that could

revision_stamps.sampled: code_cleanliness.git_sha is read while the writer computes; code.git_sha is read when the result is written. Both are HEAD of the same checkout at two moments
revision_stamps.reading: no revision race: both stamps record 8994fca

traced_inputs.note: Every file this writer opened for reading under data/ was recorded by an audit hook on the "open" event, canonicalised through data/'s links so one file has one spelling, and compared against the inputs the manifest declares; a member of a declared group counts as declared and hashed on its own, a file under a declared directory counts as declared by prefix. The hook is per interpreter, so a file read by a subprocess is not in this record, nor is one reached through a path that canonicalises to neither this checkout's data/ nor one of its link targets.
